author: zeph713
quote:
First of all, I'd like to clarify that I might be a little biased and uninformed about the rest of the AC games, since I have only played FromSoftware's games that are from the Souls genre (including Sekiro and Bloodborne, of course).

The only real downside that I see from people here is the fact, that the game is "hard". I really don't see this being a real thing, tho. Again, it might be just me being an "elitist Souls veteran", who is talking about skill issues, but I literally defeated the first boss from my second try. The game feels smooth and yet weird, as this is my first AC game. I have played only the first mission and I will keep updating my comment on the game.

My first impressions are rather positive: the game is far from the best FromSoftware game I have played, but it is still better than the vast majority of the modern games. For me personally, the story has almost no meaning, as the gameplay and combat are the most important things by far. Sure, having a great story does help, but it is not as important for me.

I dislike games with 70% cut scenes. I suppose that people who enjoy "no **** combat" type of games would also enjoy this game quite a bit. The game feels like a breath of fresh air for me and I haven't seen this level of combat (outside of a FromSoftware title) since maybe Devil May Cry 5.
